correctness.rationale: The radial Laguerre densities are probability densities with all-index sum 1, giving an exact twice-outside-mass identity. Exact Laguerre Jacobi moments give mean j+r+1 and variance 2jr+j+r+1. The fixed-r generating formula implies a locally uniform Hermite-squared edge density; moment-based tightness upgrades it to distributional convergence. An O_r(1/M) Chebyshev tail estimate closes the global Riemann sum. Mehler diagonal identity and an elementary Gaussian integral yield the exact even/odd central-binomial constants. The standalone checker passed 58 supplementary tests, not substituted for the proof.
